c.title: $4,600 / 2br - 1126ft2 - Near UBC 2 Bed 1 Den 2.5 Bath Apartment (Point Grey)
c.description:
This spacious 2 bedroom 1 Den 2.5 bathroom apartment offers approximately 1,126 sq. ft. featuring an open outlook and a practical, well-designed layout.
The home features central air conditioning, hardwood flooring throughout, and a bright living environment with plenty of natural light. The additional half bathroom provides added convenience for everyday use and guests. One parking stall is included.
Conveniently located in Vancouver's Point Grey area, the property offers easy access to UBC, schools, parks, shopping, and neighbourhood amenities. Lord Byng Secondary School is approximately an 8-minute walk away, while Queen Elizabeth Elementary School and Carnarvon Elementary School are about a 15-minute walk. UBC is approximately a 5-minute drive away, making this location convenient for commuting to campus and surrounding areas.

PROPERTY DETAILS:
- Status: Available Oct 1st
- Unfurnished
- Rent $4600/month, Utility not included
- One Parking included

RENTAL TERMS:
- Minimum 1-year lease term required
- 1/2 month's rent for security deposit
- Moving Fees: As per strata bylaws
- Tenant Insurance required
- Pets are NOT allowed.
- No subletting, No smoking
